title: Grateful Dead Live at O'Keefe Center on 1967-08-05

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of an electric show highlighted by a ripping Turn On Your Lovelight and a monster Alligator jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean soundboard source that fans say sounds great with a little EQ tweaking, making every nuance audible. Musically the night is fire‑brand – Pigpen and Jerry tear up the first “Turn on Your Lovelight” and the band launches into an all‑time classic Alligator jam that feels both tight and free‑form. Energy stays high throughout and no detracting moments are noted.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviewers gave 5‑star ratings, praising both the performance (especially Alligator) and the soundboard quality; no negatives were mentioned.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced board recording; reviewers suggest EQ for optimal playback but report no dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opener with an energetic Lovelight followed by a seamless transition into the soaring Alligator jam, keeping momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for “tearing up the place” and delivering powerful guitar work throughout the set.
